model.name: CROMA
model.pretraining_dataset: SSL4EO-S12 paired Sentinel-1 GRD and Sentinel-2 L2A

checkpoints.serialization_warning: The official .pt files use PyTorch pickle serialization. Download only from the pinned official source, verify SHA-256 before torch.load, and do not accept user-supplied checkpoints.

official_input_contract.optical_semantics: Sentinel-2 surface-reflectance bands with B10/cirrus removed
official_input_contract.spatial_size_constraint: Height and width must be multiples of 8; 120 x 120 is the pretraining/default size.

reference_normalization.scope: for each channel, statistics are calculated across the current input tensor batch and spatial axes
reference_normalization.operation: min-max scale to [0,1] and clip; the example optionally quantizes through uint8 [0,255] then divides by 255

official_input_contract.order_finding: The inspected official paper, README, use_croma.py, and pretrain_croma.py define channel counts and sensor semantics but do not name a positional channel order. An order must not be inferred from convention.

compatible_facts: Both use paired Sentinel-1 dual-polarization SAR and Sentinel-2 Level-2A multispectral observations.
BigEarthNet v2 supplies VV and VH and the same 12 stored Sentinel-2 bands after B10/cirrus exclusion.
BigEarthNet's 1200 m footprint becomes 120 x 120 at the 10 m CROMA input grid.
CROMA exposes independent SAR-only and optical-only encoders, matching the required Phase 4 unimodal ablation.

mismatches_and_open_contracts.detail: BigEarthNet v2 preserves 10 m, 20 m, and 60 m Sentinel-2 grids, whereas CROMA consumes all 12 channels on one 120 x 120 grid.
mismatches_and_open_contracts.required_resolution: Freeze an explicit per-band resampling profile after validating actual GeoTIFF alignment; do not rewrite native assets.

mismatches_and_open_contracts.detail: CROMA's official artifacts do not state whether VV precedes VH or the positional order of the 12 optical bands.
mismatches_and_open_contracts.required_resolution: Trace or obtain the official SSL4EO/CROMA tensor construction order before implementing the adapter.

mismatches_and_open_contracts.detail: The official example uses batch-dependent per-channel mean +/- 2 standard deviations, which makes an image's values depend on batch composition.
mismatches_and_open_contracts.required_resolution: Reproduce and test the reference behavior, then freeze an inference-safe deterministic profile only if equivalence or a validation decision supports it.

mismatches_and_open_contracts.detail: BigEarthNet documents terrain-corrected dB backscatter; the CROMA paper names SSL4EO Sentinel-1 GRD VV/VH but does not fully specify the value pipeline in the inference contract.
mismatches_and_open_contracts.required_resolution: Confirm SSL4EO/CROMA SAR units and inspect a real BigEarthNet sample before asserting distribution compatibility.

decision.why: It is a compact, established OSS radar-optical model with separate optical and SAR encoders, a joint path reserved for later work, and a native 120 x 120 Sentinel input scale matching BigEarthNet's 1200 m footprint at 10 m.
decision.registration_policy: Do not add CROMA to the production model/preprocessing registries until channel order, resampling, numeric scaling, and NoData behavior are verified and tested in Phase 4B.
decision.fusion_policy: Phase 4 uses only optical-only and SAR-only modes. The supported joint mode is not evidence of successful fusion and is out of scope until Phase 5.
